Miscellaneous Services, Etc., in Certain Localities

law.catch_line: Permit for onsite sewage disposal system installation in certain counties
law.text: Augusta County may require any person desiring to install a septic tank or other onsite sewage disposal system to secure a permit to do so. A reasonable fee may be prescribed, not to exceed $150, for processing an application for such a permit.
